body.lit: [When Digivolving] If you have 5 or fewer security cards, <Recovery +1 (Deck)>. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.) Then, when DNA digivolving, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose level is less than or equal to the number of cards in your security stack to its owner's hand.

label.lit: Recovery +1 (Deck) and return 1 Digimon to hand

body.lit: [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
